newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Esso Rotterdam flexi-coker start-up in progress.
newsitem.headline: Esso Rotterdam flexi-coker start-up in progress.

text.p: The flexi-coker at Exxon's Esso Netherlands Rotterdam refinery is in the process of being restarted, a company spokesman said on Monday.
"(We are) busy restarting (the flexi-coker),... but it is always very difficult to say when it will actually start up," he said.
The absence of the unit has left the company as a seller of high sulphur fuel oil in the ARA barge market, traders said on Monday.
They added a start-up should be manageable within a week.
A power outage in the Rotterdam area two weeks ago caused the closure of the entire refinery, but, apart from the flexi-coker, all other units were back in operation by the end of last week.
